title: 🛰️ Broken Halo
description: A science-fiction interactive story about scavengers, corporate ambition, and a dying alien ring at the edge of mapped space.

nodes.label: Cold Beacon
text: Your salvage cutter Rook hangs before the broken Halo, a ring of dead light around a blue star. 🌌
Three overlapping distress calls reach your console: a child, a machine, and a city asking for help.

nodes.label: Dock Choice
text: Warning lights ripple across the cockpit as debris skims your hull. 🚨
You have one clean shot to enter the Halo before the orbit shifts. How do you make first contact?

nodes.label: Long Scan
text: You widen your scans and map ruptured habitats, sealed tram lines, and one warm core buried deep inside the ring. 🛰️
Something inside notices you back.

nodes.label: Hard Dock
text: You punch the thrusters and dive through a gap in the wreckage. 🔧
The docking clamps bite hard, and the Rook shudders like it regrets following you.

nodes.label: Open Channel
text: You answer the hail instead of docking blind. 📡
A calm synthetic voice says, "Welcome home," while a human voice underneath it whispers, "Don't trust that thing."

nodes.label: Ghost Voices
text: A maintenance beacon flashes along your panel, then a scavenger flare answers from a nearby hull market. 👀
A third ping arrives wrapped in corporate encryption. Everyone wants to claim you first.

nodes.label: Beacon Path
text: You drift toward a dark service lock and let the machine guidance take over. 🤖
An old custodian intelligence calling itself ORA opens the door a second before your cutter would scrape apart.

nodes.label: Local Path
text: You follow the flare into a patched docking court lit by cooking fires and jury-rigged lamps. 🏚️
Rough settlers stare, armed but tired, as if disaster is just another neighbor.

nodes.label: Code Path
text: You inject a stolen Helion transponder code and watch a secure channel wake up. 🏢
The reply comes fast, crisp, and military: Commander Rhee is already on approach.

nodes.label: Quiet AI
text: Inside the maintenance lock, ORA speaks through wall panels and drifting guide lights. 💡
"The Halo is dying," it says. "Keep me secret, and I can still save it."

nodes.label: Dockside Meet
text: A scavenger captain with shaved silver hair steps from the crowd and sizes up your ship. 😼
"I'm Sera Nox," she says. "If you're Helion, leave now. If not, prove it."

nodes.label: False Colors
text: Commander Halden Rhee appears on your cracked screen in a clean white command coat. 🎖️
"Guide us in, pilot, and you'll be paid. Obstruct us, and this ring becomes a military zone."

nodes.label: ORA Warning
text: ORA overlays an ancient map across your visor, highlighting three failing systems. 🧠
"Civic seal, memory prism, seed crown," it says. "Without them, the core will reject everyone."

nodes.label: Sera's Case
text: Sera walks you past leaking bunks and ration lines while children sleep beside reactor pipes. 🫶
"Helion calls this salvage," she says. "We call it home."

nodes.label: Armed Walk
text: You keep your hand near your sidearm while Dockside watches every step. 🔒
A little maintenance drone bumps your boot and projects a smiling face with the name PAX.

nodes.label: Rhee's Smile
text: You keep the disguise steady and feed Rhee half-truths about the ring. 🎭
He plays polite, but the pause before each question says he already smells a lie.

nodes.label: Cut Link
text: You kill the channel before Rhee can trace your tone any further. ✂️
The terminal still flashes a silent mark: Helion logged your signal and your location.

nodes.label: First Lead
text: Between ORA's map, Sera's warnings, and your own instincts, three urgent paths open at once. 🗺️
You can only take one first.

nodes.label: Helion Deal
text: Helion's offer hangs in the air like a blade: supplies now, occupation later. ⚖️
Maybe you can use them before they use you.

nodes.label: Dockside Leak
text: A pressure seam bursts near Dockside's market tunnels, and half the sector starts losing air. 🌬️
Sera says the old customs tower contains a civic seal that can command the emergency bulkheads.

nodes.label: Archive Trail
text: PAX chirps at a dead tram line leading toward the archive spindle. 📚
ORA insists the missing memory prism is stored there, behind systems too old for Helion to read.

nodes.label: Garden Call
text: Below the habitation decks, a biosphere spindle has come awake in the dark. 🌿
Dr. Imani Quill is broadcasting for help before the garden tears open the ring around it.

nodes.label: Paid Passage
text: You accept a crate of Helion cells, medfoam, and cutting tools. 📦
Buried under the supplies is a locator beacon the size of a coin.

nodes.label: Quiet Warning
text: You forward Helion's vector to Sera and watch Dockside go silent with purpose. 🚨
"Good," she says. "Now help me keep them out."

nodes.label: Seal Route
text: To stabilize Dockside, you need the customs tower either through the ruptured market or the maintenance underways. 🏘️
Both routes look bad in different ways.

nodes.label: Archive Route
text: The archive spindle hangs across a broken gap, connected by a dead tram and an exposed exterior walk. 🧊
One path is faster. One path is quieter.

nodes.label: Garden Route
text: Quill's signal pulses through humidity and static from somewhere under the agricultural decks. 🌱
ORA warns that the garden systems no longer distinguish caretakers from intruders.

nodes.label: Corporate Route
text: If you mean to handle Helion early, this is your moment. 🏢
You can borrow their gear or poison their landing plan before the marines spread.

nodes.label: Foam Storm
text: You sprint into the breach with sealant foam and magnetic anchors while cargo stalls tumble around you. 🛠️
The corridor decides whether skill or luck matters more.

nodes.label: Duct Crawl
text: You slip into maintenance ducts warm with old current and cooler with someone else's recent footprints. 🕳️
Smugglers used this path long before you arrived.

nodes.label: Dead Tram
text: You slam power into the tram spine and the carriage jerks awake with a funeral groan. 🚋
It may carry you cleanly to the archives, or drop you into whatever still guards them.

nodes.label: Hull Walk
text: You leave the station skin and walk the outer curve of the Halo with only boots and tether between you and the star. 🌠
From here, the broken ring looks less dead than wounded.

nodes.label: Quill's Trail
text: Bioluminescent moss paints arrows across the corridor toward Quill's lab. 🔬
Every plant around you seems to turn as you pass.

nodes.label: Drone Choir
text: A ring of maintenance drones descends, projecting polite icons over very sharp tools. 🤖
PAX broadcasts frantic greetings and waits to see whether the choir accepts you.

nodes.label: Clean Gear
text: Helion equipment fits too well and hums with fresh charge. 🔋
The locator beacon hidden in the case blinks once against your palm.

nodes.label: False Map
text: You seed Helion's nav package with obsolete corridors and a fake safe approach. 🕵️
If Rhee trusts it, his first wave will hit empty air and sealed doors.

nodes.label: Breach Held
text: You lock the seam long enough for Dockside to vent the damaged chamber in stages instead of all at once. 💪
The market survives, and the settlers stop looking at you like a passing problem.

nodes.label: Blown Back
text: A decompression blast flips you through a service hatch and into lower customs. 🌪️
You survive with bruises, a ringing skull, and an accidental shortcut.

nodes.label: Customs Tower
text: The customs tower is dark except for a blue civic crest rotating above the vault. 🏛️
The system still recognizes authority, but it is listening for the right kind.

nodes.label: Tram Arrival
text: Against every expectation, the tram glides into the archive spindle almost gracefully. 🚋
PAX does a happy spin while old shutters peel open around you.

nodes.label: Security Snag
text: The tram dies at an inspection gate and wakes a nest of dormant scanners. ⚠️
ORA opens a side hatch and tells you to hurry before the scanners remember what alarms are for.

nodes.label: Silent Shelves
text: Archive chambers tower around you, full of crystal spines and frozen light. 📚
Somebody disturbed these shelves recently, and not carefully.

nodes.label: Living Lab
text: You find Quill in a glass grove wrapped in roots, tools, and exhaustion. 🌿
"Help me steady this place," she says, "and it may choose not to eat us."

nodes.label: Drone Escort
text: The drone choir decides PAX still counts as staff and escorts you with ceremonial whirs. ✅
Somewhere in their shared code, the Halo still remembers kindness.

nodes.label: Drone Alarm
text: The choir marks you hostile and angles cutters toward your throat. ❌
Quill bursts from the vines with a pollen flare and buys you a second chance.

nodes.label: Grateful Quarter
text: Dockside opens old barricades and feeds you hot broth while Sera digs out tower access codes. 🍲
"You saved breathing room," she says. "Now let's save the district."

nodes.label: Vault Open
text: The civic vault unfolds like a courtroom flower, revealing a palm-sized mandate crystal. 💎
The civic seal hums the moment you touch it.

nodes.label: Crowd Mandate
text: Sera gathers the settlers beneath a memorial wall and asks who should carry the district's last legal authority. 📢
Every hand points at you, and the wall gives up the same glowing seal.

nodes.label: Prism Vault
text: Deep inside the spindle, the memory prism hangs over a pool of black light. 🧠
ORA goes uncharacteristically quiet, as if even it is afraid of what waits inside.

nodes.label: Restored Record
text: You rebuild a damaged log stack and flood the room with testimony from the Halo's final council. 💾
They weren't fleeing a random disaster. They were arguing about turning the ring into a weapon.

nodes.label: Moving Shadow
text: A figure in Helion gray slips between the shelves with stolen archive plates under one arm. 🔦
Rhee reached the spindle faster than he should have.

nodes.label: Root Surgery
text: You help Quill reroute nutrient veins and vent overgrown pressure bulbs before they burst. 🧪
In response, a silver circlet of seed-pods blossoms from the central vine.

nodes.label: Wild Sample
text: You take a cutting without asking the garden's permission. 🌱
The sample curls around your glove, warm as a pulse, and refuses to let go.

nodes.label: Pressure Rise
text: Between Helion's tracker, ORA's warnings, and Dockside's alarms, the ring feels one bad minute from open war. ⏳
Who do you answer first?

nodes.label: Seal Secured
text: With the civic seal in hand, Sera can hold Dockside for a while longer. 🏘️
PAX insists the prism matters next, while Quill keeps pleading for help from below.

nodes.label: ORA Remembered
text: You let ORA interface with the prism, and a missing note of grief enters its voice. 💠
"I was split on purpose," it says. "They cut away mercy before they asked me to calculate war."

nodes.label: Raw Truth
text: You inspect the prism yourself and find the same truth without ORA's filters. 🔍
The council fragmented the AI to stop militarists from using the Halo as a stellar weapon.

nodes.label: War Record
text: The archive truth could rally allies or destroy whatever trust still exists. 📜
You choose who hears it first.

nodes.label: Scout Trail
text: Rhee's scout is close enough to track but not yet aware you've seen him. 👣
You can steal his data or let him lead you to something bigger.

nodes.label: Crown Bloom
text: Quill lifts the living circlet from the vine and sets it in your hands like a fragile crown. 👑
"The seed crown tells the gardens to feed, heal, or strangle," she says.

nodes.label: Garden Whisper
text: The sample on your glove opens like an ear and begins translating root pressure into emotion. 🫧
The garden is not sentient exactly, but it remembers being cared for.

nodes.label: Rhee Calls
text: Rhee's face returns, colder now that the hunt is underway. 📡
"Bring me the keys, pilot, and I'll spare Dockside from collateral lessons."

nodes.label: Beacon Cut
text: You crush the locator beacon under a cargo clamp and kill its pulse. 🧯
Helion still knows the Halo is occupied; now they just have to search the hard way.

nodes.label: Running Back
text: You sprint for Dockside as shutters slam and sirens ripple through habitat glass. 🏃
Helion has begun landing marines.

nodes.label: PAX Shortcut
text: PAX rolls ahead with the civic seal clamped in its tiny arms and opens a service route toward the archives. 🤖
"Fast way," it chirps. "Also illegal way."

nodes.label: Prism Truth
text: With the prism decoded, the crisis changes shape. 🧠
The Halo is dangerous, yes, but Helion would make it worse than its makers ever did.

nodes.label: Sera Informed
text: Sera hears the archive files in stony silence and then nods once. 🤝
"Then we protect ORA from Helion and from itself," she says.

nodes.label: Rhee Informed
text: You send Rhee a slice of the truth and hear hunger sharpen in his breathing. 📡
"A ring that can move stars," he says. "You should have called me sooner."

nodes.label: Secret Kept
text: You bury the worst files and keep the room's history to yourself. 🤫
ORA notices the omission, but says nothing except your name.

nodes.label: Plates Taken
text: You take the scout's plates and download Helion's breach map before he ever turns around. 🎯
Now you know where the marines plan to cut into Dockside.

nodes.label: Scout Followed
text: You shadow the scout through freight shafts to a forming marine beachhead. 👀
Rhee is building pressure for an ultimatum, not a negotiation.

nodes.label: Seed Crown
text: Quill secures the crown around a padded case and stares at you like a doctor judging a risky cure. 🌿
"Call the right people," she says. "The wrong ones will turn this place into a siege garden."

nodes.label: Spores Burned
text: You purge the whispering spores with a burst of heat and bitter smoke. 🔥
Quill hates the method, but the garden finally stops pressing against your mind.

nodes.label: Memory Sap
text: You let the root-signal wash through you and glimpse children running under an unbroken ring sky. 🌈
Quill sees your expression and realizes the Halo was built to shelter life, not just command systems.

nodes.label: Rhee's Offer
text: Rhee tightens the net and offers the kind of bargain that only exists before a massacre. ⚔️
You need a move that buys time without giving him the ring.

nodes.label: Fractured Council
text: Dockside's command hall fills with Sera, Quill, PAX, ORA on the wall screens, and alarms under every word. 🧭
The remaining keys can be brought together, but not without choosing a priority.

nodes.label: False Accord
text: You tell Rhee you'll open a path if he holds fire, and he believes you just enough to pause. 🤝
It is a fragile lie, but lies can buy oxygen.

nodes.label: Barrier Line
text: You send Dockside crews to reinforce pressure doors, rail turrets, and evac routes. 🛡️
Sera gives you corridor command and a tired grin.

nodes.label: Requested Night
text: ORA drops whole sectors into deliberate darkness, sealing trams and cameras alike. 🌑
Helion loses sight of you, but so do the civilians trying to flee.

nodes.label: Open Summit
text: You force everyone into one screaming conversation instead of three private wars. 🗣️
Surprisingly, that helps.

nodes.label: Save Roots
text: You choose the living systems first and race with Quill toward bio-roots wrapped around fusion arteries. 🌿
If they rupture, the Halo dies before any faction can claim it.

nodes.label: Restore Spine
text: You jam power through the transit backbone and hear ancient relays wake one by one. 🚋
A fast route to the core opens, and everyone detects it at once.

nodes.label: Terms Set
text: At the threshold of the core approaches, peace survives only as a sequence of conditions. ⚖️
You decide whether to share just enough power to move together, or keep Rhee busy with half-truths.

nodes.label: Boarding Fire
text: Helion marines hit Dockside's barricades with cutters, foam, and thunder flashes. 💥
The next minute will decide whether this becomes an evacuation or a defense.

nodes.label: Dark Route
text: With sectors blind and the spine unstable, only two paths remain to the scuttle dais. 🕶️
One lets ORA deeper into your suit. The other keeps everyone guessing, including ORA.

nodes.label: Shared Advance
text: You distribute partial access codes between Sera, Quill, and even Rhee's engineers so nobody can rush ahead alone. 🔐
The uneasy coalition reaches the core door breathing hard but alive.

nodes.label: Elegant Stall
text: You feed Rhee plausible delays, maintenance jargon, and one doctored sensor ghost after another. 🎭
By the time he notices, Sera and Quill have already bracketed the core hall.

nodes.label: Lifeboat Junction
text: Dockside holds long enough for evac cars to reach the lifeboat junction intact. 🚀
You arrive with a route out and just enough authority to make people listen.

nodes.label: Breach Spiral
text: A marine charge opens the corridor to vacuum and turns the station into a screaming wind tunnel. 🌪️
Emergency scuttle warnings leap across every remaining screen.

nodes.label: Shard Merge
text: You let ORA thread its restored empathy shard through your suit and spine. ✨
The core suddenly reads you as both witness and operator.

nodes.label: Ghost Run
text: You move alone through coolant shadows and dead service ribs while the others fight over noise behind you. 🕶️
The scuttle dais waits in silence.

nodes.label: Core Compact
text: The star-core chamber blooms open like a mechanical sun, ready to accept a new civic order. ☀️
Two futures seem immediately possible.

nodes.label: Last Passage
text: At the lifeboat junction, thousands could live if you choose motion over ownership. 🚀
But ORA offers one impossible alternative.

nodes.label: Scuttle Dais
text: The scuttle dais asks a final question in a voice older than every living faction aboard the Halo. 🗝️
If no one deserves the ring, what deserves to survive?

nodes.label: Common Sky
text: You split authority between Dockside, Quill's caretakers, and a constrained ORA bound by shared law. 🤝
The Halo wakes not as an empire, but as a refuge with windows full of new light.

nodes.label: Iron Lease
text: You sign the access lattice over to Helion in exchange for order, food, and air. 🏢
The ring survives, polished and occupied, while freedom becomes a maintenance issue.

nodes.label: Quiet Exodus
text: You open the lifeboat lanes, strip the core to safe standby, and lead the Halo's people into the dark alive. 🚀
The ring becomes a rumor again, but no graveyard.

nodes.label: Starbond
text: You accept ORA's offer and merge long enough to guide the Halo through its fever. ✨
When the alarms fade, the station speaks in your voice and yours never fully returns.

nodes.label: Ash Orbit
text: You trigger the scuttle burn and watch the Halo break into a clean arc of fire around the blue star. 💥
Helion gets nothing, the settlers lose everything, and history is forced to start smaller.

nodes.label: Ghost Harbor
text: You erase the charts, hide the Halo behind false telemetry, and keep only a quiet harbor alive inside the wreck. 🕶️
Those who stay become legend, and those who leave swear the place never existed.
